title: Hosted AI: run build and ask on haiku at effort medium (eval#1 recommendation, 5-rep evidence)
body:
eval#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzr7AespGQoymAnLtn

Filed by eval#1 (#33468) here with `domain:cloud` + `repo:cloud`, because the filing account has no write on objectstack-ai/cloud (the relay refused: zero writes). Evidence: the run record #33920 (public, maintainer ruling 2026-11-15 on the eval seat's decision card: records go to objectstack like `qa-run`).

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed, verbatim (eval seat thread, 2026-11-15): 「你先对照选出最佳方案，然后云端可以对应调整」 · 「云端的模型建议也立上一张卡，带上你的测试卡」.

## Why (business)

The hosted product builds apps and answers questions with haiku by default (maintainer, 2026-11-15). The question was whether a different model or effort level is worth it. Customers building locally with Claude Code most likely use opus, so opus is the reference.

## Recommendation

- **Keep haiku for both build and ask, and set effort to `medium`.**
- Ask (read-only questions) and Build score the same for haiku default, haiku medium and opus low across 5 repetitions, so no model change is needed there.
- Writes a user asks for in chat (add / move / remove records) are where configs differ: haiku default 65.5% → haiku medium 71.4% → opus low 80.7%. Effort medium is the cheapest gain (+6 points for about +17% nominal cost).
- opus is a further +9 points on writes and the most stable, at 13–15× the cost. Whether write-heavy turns route to opus is a product call, not part of this card.

## What to change

- Wherever the hosted build and ask turns choose their model, pass effort `medium` with haiku. In Claude Code terms that is `--effort medium` / `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=medium`; the hosted path's own equivalent is the cloud lane's to find.
- Record the effort beside the served model in whatever the hosted turn logs, so later evals can tell which level ran.

## Acceptance

- Hosted build and ask turns run haiku with effort medium, and the logged turn shows both.
- eval#1 re-runs its weekly control-card round on the new setting (its schedule already tracks haiku medium) and posts the result on this card.

## Not in scope

- The ask-accuracy baseline (`packages/service-ai-studio/src/evals/run-ask-accuracy-cli.ts`) and the hosted chat set are API-billed and run only within a maintainer-approved budget; they are not re-run here.
